segments.text: Ok so this is the Fixed Schema A2UI page for OpenAI Agents with Vue, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, umm, the catalog renderers are only given in React.
And the catalog is registered on the React provider, there's no Vue version of this anywhere.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the common model file, wasn't on the page, so I had to add it myself.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for a flight, it should show the flight card, but I just get a red error saying the flight catalog was not found.
So basically, the agent sends the flight surface fine, but the page only shows how to register the catalog in React, so in Vue, ahh, the card can't render.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
